description: Tracked tests/ harnesses that are deliberately not CTest gates. Each is run by hand or by a campaign. Registering one, or deleting it, removes its entry; test_throughput_registration rejects any harness that is neither registered, conditionally registered, used by another harness, run by a workflow, nor listed here.

categories.automation: Unit tests for a repository script that no workflow job runs yet.
categories.cost-evidence-controls: Mutation and provenance controls for the LLVM cost and evaluation reporters; no workload timing.
categories.performance-measurement: Timed observations that need a quiet host; not pass/fail parity gates.
categories.test-only-abi-oracle: Test-only ABI proposals or contracts, not evidence that GTI admits the operation.
categories.instrumentation: Sanitizer or memory-instrumentation runs that need an instrumented toolchain.
categories.debugger: Needs an interactive-capable debugger (LLDB) on the host.
categories.execution-review: Execution checks whose coverage may already be registered elsewhere; review for registration.
